stories.headline: Fed officials open door to a half-point hike after inflation beats expectations
stories.summary: Fed officials signaled openness to a 50 basis point rate hike following inflation data that exceeded forecasts. This marks a potential shift toward more aggressive monetary tightening.
stories.why_matters: Rate expectations drive equity valuations and bond yields; hawkish Fed guidance directly impacts S&P 500 and Treasury pricing.

stories.headline: Wall St falls as hot inflation data fuels rate-hike jitters
stories.summary: Wall Street declined as stronger-than-expected inflation data triggered concerns about further Federal Reserve rate increases. The market selloff reflects investor anxiety over monetary policy tightening.
stories.why_matters: Inflation surprises and rate-hike expectations are primary drivers of equity drawdowns and volatility spikes like today's 0.55% S&P 500 decline.

stories.headline: Rubio tells G7 US will keep imposing 'devastating' costs on Iran, diplomats say
stories.summary: Secretary of State Rubio conveyed to G7 nations that the US will continue an economic campaign against Iran with severe consequences. This reflects escalation in US-Iran tensions.
stories.why_matters: Geopolitical escalation with Iran affects crude oil supply expectations and global risk sentiment, impacting energy markets and equities.

calendar.note: FOMC announcement on November 13 will clarify Fed's stance on rate hikes given recent hot inflation data; direct catalyst for rates and equity repricing.
Current federal funds rates and forward guidance will be critical for confirming market expectations of a potential 50 bps hike.
Survey of key interest rates will provide context on lending conditions and market-implied rate expectations following inflation surprises.

concept.title: Inflation-Driven Rate-Hike Surprise
concept.one_liner: Hot inflation data reverses dovish rate expectations, triggering equity selloff and Treasury yield surge.
concept.explanation: Yesterday's inflation beat prompted Fed officials to signal a potential 50 bps rate hike, contradicting market expectations for cuts or pauses. This sparked a 0.55% decline in the S&P 500 and a 5 bps rise in 2Y Treasuries as investors repriced terminal rate expectations. The risk-off sentiment is reflected in a VIX decline of 5.72 points and rising real yields, which compress equity valuations by increasing discount rates.
concept.market_link: Fed credibility on inflation control directly determines the path of terminal rates, which anchors all equity multiples and corporate borrowing costs.

narrative: US equities fell 0.55% as hotter-than-expected inflation data reopened the possibility of a 50 bps Fed rate hike, driving Treasury yields higher (2Y +5 bps, 10Y +2 bps) and triggering a reassessment of monetary policy duration. Geopolitical tensions with Iran and economic policy uncertainty persist alongside the rate-hike jitters, keeping risk sentiment cautious ahead of Friday's FOMC press release.
